theme: Last day ashore before a week at sea.
greeting: Boarding day, Dan. The calendar is clear, so today is really about clearing the errands and trip logistics that need real connectivity before you cast off around five.

needsAttention.title: Confirm today's boarding, then the Sept 19 return
needsAttention.detail: Nail down the exact meeting time and spot for the Nautilus course before you head to the marina, and lock the return airport transfer for the 19th now while you can. Amy at Nautilus already sent trip wishes but not the specifics.

needsAttention.title: Last errands in Dubrovnik
needsAttention.detail: Cash (~€200 for incidentals), snacks, drinks for the week, and any gluten-free non-perishables are all easier now than underway. Nearest stores are Studenac, Tommy, and Konzum.

needsAttention.title: Set the Sept 19 Cavtat logistics
needsAttention.detail: Pre-book the Komolac to Cavtat transfer, confirm the hotel will hold your bags before the 3 PM check-in, and arrange the ~5:15 AM checkout and taxi for the Sept 20 flight. Charter connectivity is poor, so settle all three before boarding.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 20 arrival
needsAttention.detail: You go offline for a week and land in Tampa on the 20th, so book the full-size SUV (TPA, Sept 20–Oct 5) outright and confirm the St Pete Sept 20–22 gap converted before you lose signal.

schedule.title: Board the sailing charter
schedule.detail: Nautilus course out of Dubrovnik — a week aboard begins

flagged.title: Provider bill ready to pay
flagged.detail: A medical bill from an August visit is waiting whenever you're back on land — no rush today.

flagged.title: VP Government Affairs alerts
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced new governance and public-affairs roles matching your searches.

flagged.title: ICGN Toronto conference is open
flagged.detail: Bookings are live for the ICGN Autumn Conference in Toronto this November — a governance networking window.

inbox.noise: The rest is retail, newsletters, and travel promos — nothing that needs you.

resolved.title: Cavtat hotel is booked
resolved.detail: Remisens Epidaurus for the night of Sept 19 is confirmed and paid — only the transfers remain open.

recipe.title: Duck breasts with apples & caraway
recipe.why: Early autumn brings the first crisp apples, a natural match for rich duck.

acts.line: A quiet last morning ashore in Dubrovnik with nothing on the calendar.
Errands and provisioning, then to the marina to board around five.
First night aboard; tomorrow's 15-minute Sunday review with Mike lands at 9 AM ET while you're likely already underway.
